name: Pre-Echo
storyline: In August 1994, an old field radio in Greyford begins receiving voices, alarms and accidents before they happen. Investigating these signals gives players a chance to alter coming events. At night, the Resonance Storm brings a creature called the Listener, which tracks radio transmissions. Decisions made while investigating leave lasting changes in the town and its inhabitants.
summary: Pre-Echo is a first-person horror mystery adventure set in Greyford in August 1994. A radio receives signals from events that have not happened yet, allowing players to investigate warnings and intervene before they occur. Players explore the town, solve radio-based puzzles and evade a creature that hunts transmissions during the Resonance Storm. The campaign supports solo play and online co-op for up to four players, with choices that affect the town and lead to multiple endings.
